requirements.manifestNormalization: Remove all rendered text, identifiers, titles, accessibility text, and renderer identity; retain ordered visual properties and geometry.
requirements.nativeVisualStructurePolicy: Diagnostic only. Distinct valid inputs can intentionally render the same geometry, including long-form grammar aliases and reset frames without predecessors.
requirements.rasterDuplicatePolicy: Diagnostic only. Raster hashes can differ because labels differ and can match when distinct valid inputs are visually equivalent.
